name: 94597 · Walnut Creek, CA
findings: ZIP 94597 (Walnut Creek) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94597 (Walnut Creek) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 5 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
